paragraphs.text: Emma Mieko Candon is a bestselling author of speculative fiction. Their work includes Star Wars: Ronin (2021), a Japanese reimagining of the Star Wars mythos, and The Archive Undying (2023), an original speculative novel about divine AIs, giant robots made of bone, and fraught queer romance in the post-post apocalypse.
Candon contributed to the Magic Story for Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty .
